item.title: Trump says Iran ‘no longer a threat’ after 32 days — outlines next phase of US war
item.summary: Trump declares Iran "no longer a threat" after a 32-day military campaign, claiming nuclear sites were destroyed by B-2 bombers and warning of more strikes.

item.title: Hidden NYC tunnel tied to Underground Railroad at risk of ‘significant damage,’ advocates warn
item.summary: Engineers warn an Underground Railroad passageway found at NYC's Merchant's House Museum in Manhattan is threatened by a proposed nine-story development next door.

item.title: Trump is right about NATO’s weakness; the real question is how does America fix it
item.summary: The Strait of Hormuz crisis exposed NATO's deep fault lines as Germany refused to act and Spain denied airspace, revealing burden-sharing failures.

item.title: 7-month-old baby killed by stray bullet in Brooklyn shooting, police say
item.summary: Seven-month-old Kaori Patterson-Moore was killed by a stray bullet in Brooklyn after a gunman on a moped opened fire on a crowded street, police say.

item.title: Florida vice mayor found dead in home after 'domestic violence incident'; husband in police custody
item.summary: Community and political leaders reacted Wednesday to the tragic death of Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen, who was found dead in her home.

item.title: Behind the scenes of Congress' eleventh-hour rush to fund the DHS
item.summary: Congress used voice votes and rare procedural maneuvers to end the six-week DHS shutdown, with the House ultimately accepting the Senate-passed bill.

item.title: Local Dem leader says he was not 'an aggressor' after arrest for hitting man with bullhorn at 'No Kings' rally
item.summary: The Hernando County, Florida, Democratic Party chair says he did not act as an aggressor after allegedly hitting a man with a bullhorn at a "No Kings" protest.

item.title: Sham Philadelphia coffee shop hiding crack operation busted in sweeping raid, 17 arrested: AG
item.summary: Philadelphia officials dismantled a drug ring at a sham coffee shop in 'Operation Cocaine and Coffee,' arresting 17 and seizing 27 guns and drugs.

item.title: Former Cowboys player Trysten Hill appears to grin after arrest tied to alleged assault of pregnant woman
item.summary: Former NFL player Trysten Hill was taken into custody in Ellis County, Texas, on charges of assaulting a pregnant woman and interfering with an emergency request for assistance.

item.title: Bill Self announces return to Kansas sideline, set for 24th season despite health issues
item.summary: Kansas head coach Bill Self, who owns 855 career wins and two national titles, said he is returning for the 2026-27 season with championship goals in mind.
